name: @usdk/contracts
description: Minimal public types, candidate/vote/capability shapes, and the canonical wire encoding used for content digests. No dependency on any other @usdk/* package. Mirrors include/usdk/{candidate,vote,plugin,wire}.h from the native C SDK - see docs/UAGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md for the field-by-field correspondence and where the two intentionally diverge (JS round_id is a plain number, not a fixed-width struct field; content digests are not required to match bit-for-bit between the C and JS implementations, since they are independent systems joined only at the connected-mode wire protocol - see packages/binding-javascript).
